notable_absence.finding: No 'run now' shape - logging configuration changes take effect through normal config application, with no scheduled task being bypassed.

cross_component_finding: sgw:log-key's fixed catalog (Table 2: Admin, Access, Auth, Bucket, Cache, Changes, CRUD, DCP, Events, gocb, HTTP, HTTP+, Import, Javascript, Migrate, Query, Replicate, SGCluster, Sync, SyncMsg, WS, WSFrame) is exactly the kind of enumerated-and-closed vocabulary the registry excerpt flagged sgw:channel as NOT having ('freeform label created implicitly by the sync function, no product-defined catalog'). Worth flagging for reconciliation: this batch mints two superficially similar 'tag' concepts (sgw:channel, freeform; sgw:log-key, closed enum) in the same product, and conflating them would be a mistake specific to this round's material.
cross_product_finding: None stated on this page - it is entirely Sync-Gateway-internal, describing its own log file naming/rotation scheme (sg_error.log, sg_warn.log, etc.) with no comparison to Couchbase Server's log:log-file concept, even though the underlying problem (per-node log files needing retention/rotation policy) is structurally the same one Server's manage-logging.md solves. This is a genuine instance of the round's hypothesis being tested: this page needed its OWN sgw:-prefixed vocabulary (sgw:continuous-logging, sgw:console-logging, sgw:log-key, sgw:log-level-enum) rather than reusing log:log-file, confirming the round's own instruction ('Sync Gateway's own logging.md almost certainly needs its own sgw:-prefixed parallel rather than reuse').
